Key findings read these before drilling in

Gap
holdStock can let two last-unit holds both succeed. The check and the reserve are separate writes, and POST /holds has no concurrent case.
Blast
resolveRefundAmount can refund more than the remaining balance. POST /refunds returns the requested amount and never caps it.
Covered
Hold expiry is already covered. tests/hold-expiry.test.js:18 checks that a swept hold frees the unit and the storefront shows it.

Risks and unknowns risks of this change itself

Stock can go negative under two concurrent holds. POST /holds still accepts both when only one unit is left.

A refund can exceed what the customer paid. Callers of POST /refunds see a settled amount the ledger did not cap.
